end.parentNote: Pari practised storing drinking water in a clean, covered container and using a ladle or tap instead of putting hands in the water. They explained why covering the container helps keep out dust, insects, and germs. They asked about buckets and mentioned using a clean plate as a cover for a matka; this point was not fully resolved before the lesson ended. At home, ask Pari to show the safe way to cover and take water from each container used at home.
